description: Incident-response triage across an ssh auth log and a web access log: identify the brute-force source, the compromised account, the first successful login time, the privilege-escalation command and the persistence account, and write them as key=value lines into a timeline report.

criteria: The report derives all five facts from the logs - attacker_ip=198.51.100.23 (five failed passwords then Accepted for svc_backup, not the decoy scanner), compromised_account=svc_backup, first_success=02:14:37, escalation_command=/bin/cat /etc/shadow (the sudo line) and persistence_user=backdoor (the useradd) - and correlates the web log as the same source IP probing /admin.
